inputs.global_prompt: Photorealistic cinematic neo-noir crime drama, 16:9. Natural skin with visible pores, realistic materials, hard industrial lighting, organic depth of field. <Picture 1> is crime boss Wu Ya: exact facial bone structure, sleek dark hair, dark tailored suit. <Picture 2> is the henchman: short crew haircut, subservient, dark clothing. <Picture 3> is an underground boxing gym: octagonal iron cage ring, concrete mezzanine with metal railings, harsh overhead spotlights, smoky crowd. <Picture 4> is a lit cigarette: white rolled paper, burning orange ember, thin curling smoke. No beautification, no anime stylization, no on-screen text or subtitles, no background music.
inputs.local_prompts:

He raises <Picture 4> to his lips, inhales as the ember glows orange, lowers his hand and exhales a dense plume of white smoke. Cold gaze fixed on the bloodstained canvas, he speaks with exact mouth articulation: <d>[Chinese] 让他打一场给我看。</d>
